description: Free slice, paid full record. Score history of one coin: every recorded change to its 8 metric scores as a dated record with the TVR Score, the method version, a source label (baseline for the opening record, auto_captured for rows written from the change itself), the public reason where recorded and a SHA-256 hash per record; forward-only from the day the record began. Without scope (or scope "free"): the last 90 days or the last 3 records, free, no payment, no key. scope "full": the whole record, $0.05 per pull paid in-band with x402 (USDC on Base) or MPP (USDC.e on Tempo) once the record extends beyond the free slice; until then the free record is returned and nothing is charged. Data from True Value Rankings (truevaluerankings.com).

coin.description: Ticker or name of a coin covered by TVR (BTC, Bitcoin, ETH, LTC, XMR, SOL, ADA, AVAX, DOT, POL, LINK)

scope.description: free (default): the last 90 days or the last 3 records, no payment. full: the whole record, paid per pull once the record extends beyond the free slice; until then the free record is returned and nothing is charged.

name: get_historical_scores

records.description: Dated score states, newest first: as_of, revision, source, scores, tvr_score, method_version, changed_metrics, reason_public, published_at, record_hash
